title: Native S0 source snapshot exhausted its 8 s budget on a tiny test repository on Central; the slow stage is unmeasured
outcome: Native S0 source snapshot exhausted its 8 s budget on a tiny test repository on Central; the slow stage is unmeasured
acceptance: The slow S0 stage is identified from recorded per-stage timings (from a real-owner test or a real dispatch), with the run id, and classified as product, test or runner, or environment/resource.
If it is product, it is fixed or filed with its measured cost; the 8 s budget is not raised merely to obtain green.
